name: Thornsong Vale
introDiscord:
Thorned vines stretch across the Vale like instrument strings. Each
current plucks a different note while Thornsong Sirens sing through the
briars, turning the forest into a beautiful and extremely dangerous
concert.
introTwitch:
Thorned vines stretch across the Vale like instrument strings. Each
current plucks a different note while Thornsong Sirens sing through the
briars, turning the forest into a beautiful and extremely dangerous
concert.

thornsong-vale-approach.prompt: Three paths cross beneath thorn-vines humming in different keys.

left.message:
Restorative sap rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Concert medicine.

Why does forest require concert medicine?

You will understand.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the concert medicine untouched.

You do not yet understand.

This feels temporary.

right.message:
A beautiful voice calls from beyond the thorns.

You follow it for approximately three steps before noticing the Siren
attached to the voice.

And the thorns.

forward.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer rests beneath vines playing a delicate
melody. Inside are Star Candies and one thorn that immediately catches
your sleeve.

thornsong-vale-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp surrounds three passages where the music grows louder and
the briars grow thicker.

left.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's review:

'Beautiful song.
Excellent voice.
Terrible seating.
Audience nearly eaten.
★★★☆☆'

right.message:
An offering basket hangs among the thornstrings. Star Candies inside
rattle in time with the music.

forward.message:
A Thornsong Siren harmonizes perfectly with the vines.

Then the vines bend around the path.

The stage has become interactive.

thornsong-vale-threshold.prompt:
Living rootways descend toward Rose-Tide Amphitheater. Three approaches
are lined with thornstrings tuned to the same haunting melody.

left.message:
A Siren waits beneath a curtain of briars.

You recognize the opening melody.

Apparently this is the reprise.

right.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beneath Shizuki's revised review:

'Second performance.
Still beautiful.
Brought medicine.
★★★★☆.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the pool untouched. Prepared critics are healthy critics.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy bundle beneath a thorn arch shaped
like a theater curtain.

boss-antechamber.name: Rose-Tide Amphitheater
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every thornstring in the Amphitheater plays the same opening chord.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Rose-Tide Amphitheater fills with one impossible voice.

The smaller Sirens fall silent.

Thorned vines tighten across the stage as a figure rises behind them,
conducting the entire Vale with a single note.

Use /yes to stay for the final performance or /no to leave before the
audience participation becomes mandatory.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Rose-Tide Amphitheater fills with one impossible voice.

The smaller Sirens fall silent.

Thorned vines tighten across the stage as a figure rises behind them,
conducting the entire Vale with a single note.

Use !yes to stay for the final performance or !no to leave before the
audience participation becomes mandatory.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat from the Amphitheater. The final song continues without
you.

boss.revealText:
The briars sweep apart as an ancient Siren rises at center stage.

Briar-Chorus Siren reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Briar-Chorus Siren's final note fades.

The thornstrings answer with one quiet closing chord.

Shizuki's imaginary review:

Five stars.

Still terrible seating."
